EX-99.1 2 tm2620006d1_ex99-1.htm EXHIBIT 99.1 Exhibit 99.1 MetaVia Announces Completion of Dose Titration in Phase 1 Part 3 Study of DA-1726 for the Treatment of Obesity All Active Patients in Both Cohorts Have Successfully Reached Highest Target Doses of 48 mg and 64 mg Topline Data Remains on Track for Fourth Quarter 2026 CAMBRIDGE, Mass., July 9, 2026 – MetaVia Inc.

With all patients now on their target doses, we remain focused on completing treatment and reporting topline data in the fourth quarter of 2026.” The Phase 1 Part 3 trial has a planned enrollment of approximately 40 obese, otherwise healthy adult subjects, across two parts, with approximately 20 subjects per part, randomized 4:1 (16 active; 4 placebo).
